title: tissa teretifolia
intro: Tissa teretifolia, commonly known as Wild Jute, is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Tissa teretifolia are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
